reason: A DSH Web file-explorer preview plugin that renders supported FASTA, GenBank, JBEI, SnapGene, and SBOL sequence files as interactive SeqViz visualizations.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 文件浏览器中以交互式 SeqViz 视图预览 FASTA、GenBank、JBEI、SnapGene 和 SBOL 序列文件。
summaries.en: Preview FASTA, GenBank, JBEI, SnapGene, and SBOL sequence files in an interactive SeqViz viewer within the DSH Web file explorer.

capabilities: Reads supported sequence files through the file-explorer service
Parses and renders biological sequence data in an interactive viewer
Provides read-only search, annotations, topology, and display controls
